desc: Implement `feasible(L, s, numOps)` with the greedy window method described, returning True iff L is achievable.
Build `minLength` to binary search L from 1 to n, using `feasible` for each mid, and return the smallest feasible L.
Add careful boundary handling (when numOps exhausted, no further flips allowed; if L == 1, any two adjacent different chars already work, etc.).
Write at least 3 manual test cases mirroring the examples ("000001",1 → 2; "0000",2 → 1; "0101",0 → 1) and a few extra edge cases (all same, alternating, numOps = n).
Ensure overall complexity O(n log n) which fits n ≤ 1000 comfortably.
